application.name: Awesome Agentic Atlas
application.description: The static atlas index and its generated project detail pages.

flags.name: Card view by default
flags.description: Starts the main atlas in its visual card layout. Turn it off to start in the compact table; readers can still switch views.
flags.off_effect: The index starts in table view.

flags.name: Last-deployed badge
flags.description: Shows the compact clock badge with the exact UTC deployment time in the index header.
flags.off_effect: The deployment badge is omitted from the page.

flags.name: Project screenshots
flags.description: Shows each project's screenshot or GitHub social card in card and table results.
flags.off_effect: Screenshot cells and image requests are omitted; the card grid closes the gap.

flags.name: Install commands
flags.description: Shows detected one-line install commands and copy buttons in index results.
flags.off_effect: Install commands and their copy buttons are omitted from index results.

flags.name: Atlas Byte commentary
flags.description: Lets Atlas Byte show short, factual project tips when a reader hovers or focuses a project.
flags.off_effect: Atlas Byte stays visible but does not show project commentary or the Atlas Orbit easter egg.

flags.name: Export and share a view
flags.description: Offers the current view as a shareable link, a Markdown table, a standalone HTML page or print/PDF, and lets a shared #list= link be opened and saved to the reader's own projects. Everything is assembled in the reader's browser; nothing is uploaded.
flags.off_effect: The Export chip stays hidden and its dialog unreachable, a shared #list= link is ignored rather than filtering the page, and printing is left to the stylesheet rather than being switched to the table layout and light theme first.

flags.name: Install section
flags.description: Shows the detected install command, or the explanation when a project has no one-line command.
flags.off_effect: The entire Install section is omitted.

flags.name: Repository Markdown reader
flags.description: Fetches and renders README, SKILL.md and other Markdown from GitHub so a reader can inspect a project before cloning.
flags.off_effect: The reader UI is omitted and no GitHub Markdown API requests are made.

flags.name: Large screenshot
flags.description: Shows the project's screenshot or GitHub social card below the repository reader.
flags.off_effect: The screenshot section and remote image request are omitted.

flags.name: Platform support
flags.description: Shows Windows, WSL2, macOS, Linux and Docker verdicts with their evidence notes.

flags.name: Source-list provenance
flags.description: Shows which curated awesome-lists included the project and links back to those sources.

flags.name: Classification links
flags.description: Shows the project's topic and harness/integration links into the atlas taxonomy.

flags.name: Related projects
flags.description: Shows up to eight nearby projects based on shared topic, harnesses and source-list agreement.
